SessionStart.command: if command -v lantern >/dev/null 2>&1; then lantern hook session-start --agent antigravity; fi

PreInvocation.command: if command -v lantern >/dev/null 2>&1; then lantern hook prompt --agent antigravity; fi

hooks.command: if command -v lantern >/dev/null 2>&1; then lantern hook post-tool --agent antigravity; fi

PostInvocation.command: if command -v lantern >/dev/null 2>&1; then lantern hook feedback --agent antigravity; fi

Stop.command: if command -v lantern >/dev/null 2>&1; then lantern hook stop --agent antigravity; fi
